name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: prefix fd2, domain chapter_18, descriptor post_action. '18' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30), confirmed dispatched via the per-chapter post-action handler table at 0x51B19 entry index 17 (xref to 0x51b5d => (0x51b5d-0x51b19)/4 = 17). Not an address residue. Name accurately reflects purpose and logic.
purpose: Chapter 18 turn-cycle post-action handler: decides win/lose for the chapter by checking deaths of three protected allies and one boss NPC, writing the chapter event/battle-end code.
logic_summary: Reached via data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table[17]. Unlike sibling handlers it does NOT call the default fd2_check_battle_end_condition; it implements win/lose itself with two sequential independent flag writes. (1) If any of runtime_char[0], [0x10] or [0x11] is dead (short-circuit OR via fd2_check_char_is_dead), set data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code = 1 (LOSE). (2) Unconditionally afterward, if boss runtime_char[0x34] is dead, set the code = 2 (WIN). Step 2 runs after step 1 so a dead boss overrides a LOSE (fall-through win-overrides-loss: kill the boss before allies fall and the chapter is still won). Deadness queried via fd2_check_char_is_dead = runtime_char[idx].bFlags bit0.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatched cdecl argument (active char index) pushed by the dispatch site; ignored by the body (consumed only by the Watcom __CHK prologue artifact, marked (void)event_arg).
params.reason: Generic but accurate: it is the event argument the dispatched handler receives and intentionally ignores. No address residue, semantically honest. Matches sibling handlers' convention in this file.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is writing data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0x53ECC) to 1 (lose) and/or 2 (win).

notes: Source comment block (chpost.c lines 237-260) was already precise and matched the decompilation; verified dispatch index 17 from xref math, verified fd2_check_char_is_dead @ 0x3453e returns runtime_char[idx].bFlags & 1, verified protos.h:262 and globals.h:22 declarations consistent. No name/param/comment/plate changes; pure verify-and-keep. Logic already validated as correct upstream.
